summary: No hot paths touched. All additions are O(n) single passes over small in-memory lists (tasks, contracts, verdicts) inside CLI invocations that already read the same JSON files; review-brief adds one file write through the existing safe_factory_write_bytes path. pr_ready gains one dict build over the recorded verdicts — negligible against the subprocess and git calls already in that gate. No new I/O amplification, no added subprocesses, no repeated file reads (each artifact is loaded once per run).
